role: Transport a group representation, its finite observer, and an observer predicate across an invertible change of projective coordinates without mistaking one-sided composition for a representation.

input.observer: a declared probe family B and value/predicate interpretation
input.coverage: the full declared carrier, including chart boundary points

output.observed_values: H(y), or decode with H^-1 before comparison
output.evidence: identity, product, carrier, covariance, coverage, controls, costs, and residual

relation_boundary: Conjugation always represents G in H*rho(G)*H^-1.
Landing back in the same named subgroup requires H to normalize rho(G).
One-sided H*rho(g) is a left coset action on representation values, not a representation unless its laws are independently satisfied.
A projectively total Mobius map may be partial in an affine chart; deleted pole and infinity points remain a coverage residual.
applicability: H is invertible on the complete declared carrier.
Composition order and matrix scalar equivalence are frozen.
The receiver knows the source and target observer policies.
All required group and observer laws have either a proof or a declared finite check.

witness.primary: Over F_5, H=[[1,2],[1,1]] lies in PSL(2,F_5). Left translation stays in the 60-element carrier but fails the identity law and all 3600 checked ordered product pairs; conjugation preserves them all.
witness.observer: For every group element and projective point, rho_H(g)(H(x))=H(rho(g)(x)); 60 transported three-probe receipts decode exactly.
witness.affine_boundary: The affine restriction is injective on four returned F_5 values but drops input -1 and misses output 1, so the result is UnknownCoverage.

reuse: Over F_7 the same H is outside PSL(2,F_7): every one-sided output leaves the 168-element carrier, while conjugation preserves all 28224 ordered product pairs and all 1344 pointwise covariance squares.
refusal_conditions: H is singular or not total on the declared carrier.
The proposed transported action fails identity, codomain, inverse, or product laws.
Probes, output decoding, or predicates are reused without their declared coordinate transport.
A chart deletes a pole, infinity, source, or output required by coverage.
A digest, finite sample, or local injectivity is offered as unrestricted transport authority.
residual: No native Rust checked-diagram or observer transformation.
No representation of all simple groups.
No Riemann-hypothesis verification or zeta-function transport.
formation_cost: Natural-language formation and report-writing time were not separately measured; no expression or solving-cost reduction is claimed.
